title: GUI apps are started again when a workspace is restored
body:
A window decade did not start, such as a GUI app from Launch or one opened from a terminal, is not saved and not started again when a workspace is restored. decade-cc25be left this out on purpose. Jack's workflow is mostly terminals and coax, and he wants relaunching GUI apps designed on its own, later.

## Open

- Where decade gets a GUI app's command: the desktop entry it was launched from, or `/proc/<pid>/cmdline` of the client.
- Whether a restored GUI pane comes back as an empty slot before this feature exists.
